cards.title: ratings-lib: add src/ratings/notch.mjs with frozen RATING_SCALE and notchChange(previous, current), plus TDD unit tests
cards.context:
WHY: Indicators 11-13 and the REQ-06-02 notch calculator need one shared function giving the signed notch change between two credit ratings. This card adds only that function and its scale. OUT of scope: Indicators 11-13, thresholds, WL mapping, UI, CLI, logging.

REPO RULES (CLAUDE.md): plain Node.js 18+ ES modules (.mjs). No npm dependencies. Do not change package.json (test script is already 'node --test'). node:test + node:assert/strict. Code in src/ratings is pure: no I/O, no console output.

FILES (both new): src/ratings/notch.mjs, test/ratings/notch.test.mjs (.test.mjs suffix required).

CONTRACT. Exactly two named exports, no default export, NO import statements:
1) export const RATING_SCALE = Object.freeze(['AAA','AA+','AA','AA-','A+','A','A-','BBB+','BBB','BBB-','BB+','BB','BB-','B+','B','B-','CCC+','CCC','CCC-']); 19 entries, best first. notchChange reads indices from this array.
2) export function notchChange(previous, current) -> number. Synchronous. Returns index(current) - index(previous), integer -18..+18; downgrade positive, upgrade negative, unchanged 0. notchChange('BBB+','BB+') === 3, ('BB+','BBB+') === -3, ('A','A') === 0.

NORMALISATION per argument: (a) if typeof arg !== 'string' throw RangeError — BEFORE .trim(), so a non-string never surfaces as TypeError (covers String objects, objects with toString, Symbols, arrays, numbers, booleans, null, undefined/missing). (b) s = arg.trim() (String.prototype.trim only; internal whitespace stays, so 'BBB +' is unknown). (c) key = s.toUpperCase() (not toLocaleUpperCase). (d) idx = RATING_SCALE.indexOf(key); -1 -> throw RangeError (covers '', whitespace-only, 'D','CC','C','SD','NR','WD','AAA+','CCC--','BBB +','BBB+.', 'A\u2212','Baa1'). Validate both arguments before computing. Error message text is free; tests check only instanceof RangeError.

-0 RULE: compute idxCurrent - idxPrevious directly; never negate (no -(a-b)). Tests check Object.is(result, 0).

FROZEN SCALE: in an ES module RATING_SCALE.push('D') and RATING_SCALE[0]='X' must throw TypeError; scale and results unchanged afterwards.

UNIT TESTS (TDD, write first, import from '../../src/ratings/notch.mjs'; use the spec's data tables exactly): three headline examples; RATING_SCALE contents/length/frozen/mutation throws TypeError; every one-notch step forward and reversed; extremes +18/-18; full 19x19 matrix (result === j - i); Object.is(...,0) for every rating vs itself; trim and case cases; RangeError for every invalid value of AC-9/10/11 in both argument positions with 'A' as the other; notchChange() and notchChange('A'); return value is a number, not a thenable; console.log/console.error not called (stub). Do not write under test/integration/: that belongs to QA.
acceptance: AC-3: notchChange(r, r) is 0 and Object.is(result, 0) for every rating (not -0)
AC-4: RATING_SCALE has length 19 and deep-equals the C1 list, [0]='AAA', [18]='CCC-'
AC-5: RATING_SCALE is frozen; push/assignment throw TypeError and leave scale and results unchanged
AC-6: adjacent steps are 1/-1, extremes 18/-18, full 19x19 matrix result === j - i
AC-7: leading/trailing whitespace (incl. \t \n \r U+00A0 U+FEFF) is trimmed: ('  BBB+ ','BB+')=3
AC-9: unknown ratings ('D','CC','AAA+','BBB +','Baa1',...) in either position throw RangeError
AC-10: '', whitespace-only strings in either position throw RangeError
AC-11: non-strings (undefined, null, 3, Symbol, new String('A'), ...) and missing args throw RangeError, never TypeError
AC-12: returns a number synchronously, prints nothing, no import statements, no package.json dependencies
AC-13: node --test at the repo root exits 0 with the notch tests included
